title: Why AI Changed Naval's 4 Levels of Leverage Forever
alt_title_1: The Only Two Forms of Leverage You Need in 2027
alt_title_2: How One Person Outproduces a 20-Person Team
description_hook: Naval Ravikant famously identified four types of leverage: Labor, Capital, Code, and Media. This video explains why self-published leverage lets solo builders earn full-time margins in under 5 hours a week.

affiliate_cta.offer_name: Free 5-Hour Asset Builder OS + reading list
affiliate_cta.pinned_comment: Which leverage are you building right now, Code, Media, or both? 👇 Full list of free AI tools & 'Almanack of Naval' summary linked here: https://kenvh0010-lang.github.io/admin/bio/

scenes.headline: Hard Work Without Leverage Has a Ceiling
scenes.stat_label: TWICE THE HOURS, AT MOST TWICE THE OUTPUT
bullets: Effort alone scales in a straight line
Leverage is what bends the line
scenes.narration: You cannot out-work someone who has better leverage than you. Working twice as long only doubles your output, until you hit burnout.

scenes.headline: Old Leverage Needed Someone's Permission
scenes.left_body: Labor & Capital: Needs investors, bosses, or payroll
scenes.right_body: Code & Media: No gatekeepers, near-zero cost per copy
scenes.narration: For centuries, wealth required permissioned leverage: hiring people or raising millions in capital. Both required someone else to say yes to you first.

scenes.headline: AI Turned Words Into Working Software
scenes.stat_subtext: 1 Video or 1 Script works while you sleep
scenes.narration: Code and media changed the rules. A video you publish tonight or an AI script you build on Sunday can keep serving thousands of people while you sleep, at almost no extra cost.

scenes.headline: Spend 5 Hours a Week Building Assets
bullets: Keep your day job to fund peace of mind
Turn weekend curiosity into digital media + tools
scenes.narration: Stop selling every waking hour and save five hours a week to build digital assets you actually own.
scenes.source: Mind & Margin rule of thumb (advice, not a study)
